title: RRSI:噪声带内的逐轮决策(移植)
note: 移植的是 RRSI 的逐轮决策规则:噪声带下界 S' >= S* - delta、按增益分两支的成本规则(w_s dS - w_c dC + w_n nu,novelty 只在带内平票)、退火编辑预算 b_t、停滞后为未试组件保留探索槽、以及评估前的泄漏 critic;mode A 只有一个候选且无条件接受,所以 argmax 与「不可接受就停在 H_t」无法表达,记录里只做重裁决,不用来否决。

deviations.what: The acceptance floor `delta` is ours, not theirs.
deviations.why: The platform records one score per task per round and no per-trial rewards, so `delta` cannot be re-estimated from the record. The port reads `HG_RRSI_DELTA` or a fallback and records which it used.
`max_{v in T} s_v` needs a recorded discovery tree; one score per round reduces it to a best-of on a fixed task set.
